plain-footer-powered:
Footer line on every page.
"Triplespace" is the software's name and is not translated.
plain-nav-label: Accessible name of the site navigation in the global header.
plain-skip-to-content: Link at the very top of every page, visible on keyboard focus, that jumps past the header to the page's content.
plain-tabs-label: Accessible name of the row of tabs under a page's title.
plain-tabs-more: Label of the page's overflow menu beside the tabs (19 §1.3), holding the less common actions.
plain-tagline:
MediaWiki's tagline under a page's title (`#siteSub`), which Worksheet hides as MediaWiki's skins do and a wiki's styles may show.
Parameters:
* $1 - the site's name.
plain-time-julian: Marks a date in the Julian calendar.
plain-tools: Label of the page's tools menu beside the tabs (`#p-tb`): its related changes and its information.
